name: Bázakerettye (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Bázakerettye (a quartered blue and yellow shield with a bough, a monogram, an oil derrick and a plough) above a yellow scroll inscribed BÁZAKERETTYE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
